terms.comment: Our short contextual word for a smoothie. The noun is pōtiō with long ō (L&S pōtio; cf. pōtus, pōtāre); the earlier short-o spelling was corrected on 23 October 2026.

terms.gloss: a drink made from blended fruit and vegetables
terms.comment: Our explicit description, not a claimed standard Neo-Latin headword. The drink label and complete smoothie phrase are our working descriptions. Crassus/tenuis describe consistency; dulcis, acidus and amārus describe sweetness, sourness and bitterness.

phrases.english: Theo, let’s make a smoothie together.
Would you like a green smoothie or a sweet one?
